cases.coverage: Five byte-vector assertions for bytesToCrockford only.
The default call is preserved; an optional explicit date changes the result in the later revision. The baseline expectation intentionally detects that change.
UTF-8 byte counts at one/two/three/four-byte boundaries, lone surrogate replacement lengths and repeated-input cache behavior.
High/low word conversion through the maximum safe integer and actual archived Error rejection above that range.
Uniform padding tails, full-block removal, empty input and declared-length overrun guards.
